g.text: Peacefair PZEM-031 DC 8-100 V / 0-20 A, built-in shunt (TOP deck)

g.text: Amangny pigtail 3x yellow +12 V / 5x black GND -> 2x 8(6+2) male (RIGHT wall exit)

g.desc: Amangny pigtail 3x yellow +12 V / 5x black GND -> 2x 8(6+2) male (RIGHT wall exit)

g.text: Ampper 20 A rocker A=supply+ B=load+ (TOP deck)

g.desc: Ampper 20 A rocker A=supply+ B=load+ (TOP deck)

g.text: Fed from the switched side (3 = 12V_SW) so it powers down with the rig. Range 8-100 V, 0-20 A.

g.desc: Fed from the switched side (3 = 12V_SW) so it powers down with the rig. Range 8-100 V, 0-20 A.

g.text: PCIe GPU test rig - power box wiring

g.desc: PCIe GPU test rig - power box wiring

g.text: Rev A 2026-09-27. Meter terminals read off the PZEM-031 case label (top->bottom 1..4).

g.desc: Rev A 2026-09-27. Meter terminals read off the PZEM-031 case label (top->bottom 1..4).

g.text: SW1 (Ampper 3-pin): A = supply +, B = load +, yellow = LED - to GND_IN. Dot lights when ON.

g.desc: SW1 (Ampper 3-pin): A = supply +, B = load +, yellow = LED - to GND_IN. Dot lights when ON.

g.text: Shunt is internal between 2 and 1; + passes straight through 3 -> 4.

g.desc: Shunt is internal between 2 and 1; + passes straight through 3 -> 4.

g.text: M1 PZEM-031: 1 = LOAD - 2 = DC IN - 3 = DC IN + 4 = LOAD +.

g.desc: M1 PZEM-031: 1 = LOAD - 2 = DC IN - 3 = DC IN + 4 = LOAD +.

g.text: J3 PROBE GND ties to GND_OUT (LOAD -, after the shunt), not GND_IN - otherwise the probe reference shifts by the shunt drop under load.

g.desc: J3 PROBE GND ties to GND_OUT (LOAD -, after the shunt), not GND_IN - otherwise the probe reference shifts by the shunt drop under load.

g.text: F1 in the +12 V input line ahead of the switch. 15 A fast-blow; never above 20 A (meter / switch limit).

g.desc: F1 in the +12 V input line ahead of the switch. 15 A fast-blow; never above 20 A (meter / switch limit).

g.text: Internal bus 12 AWG tinned copper. Pigtail = Amangny 18 AWG with the female end cut off: 3 yellow = +12 V, 5 black = GND. Zip tie inside the wall as strain relief.

g.desc: Internal bus 12 AWG tinned copper. Pigtail = Amangny 18 AWG with the female end cut off: 3 yellow = +12 V, 5 black = GND. Zip tie inside the wall as strain relief.

g.text: Whole path rated 20 A -> ~240 W. Diagnostic rig for boot stages and rail checks, not a load tester.

g.desc: Whole path rated 20 A -> ~240 W. Diagnostic rig for boot stages and rail checks, not a load tester.

g.text: Panels: REAR = J1, J2, F1. TOP deck = SW1, M1 (+ riser dock). RIGHT wall = J4 pigtail exit, J3. FRONT = cord drawer only.

g.desc: Panels: REAR = J1, J2, F1. TOP deck = SW1, M1 (+ riser dock). RIGHT wall = J4 pigtail exit, J3. FRONT = cord drawer only.
